intro.title: Product Introduction
intro.desc1: Goalvest is a free online tool focused on goal-oriented asset planning. Our mission is to help every user better understand their financial situation, develop reasonable asset allocation plans, and plan for future financial goals.
intro.desc2: Unlike traditional financial tools, Goalvest adopts a goal-oriented design philosophy, starting from users' actual needs to provide personalized asset allocation recommendations, helping users achieve their financial freedom goals.

features.title: Core Features
features.financialAnalysisDesc: Intuitively display income, expenses, and savings to help you understand your financial health.
features.assetAllocationDesc: Provide asset allocation recommendations based on modern portfolio theory that suit your risk tolerance.
features.futureProjectionDesc: Simulate asset growth curves under different investment strategies to plan your financial future.
features.savingsEvaluationDesc: Analyze your savings rate and provide practical advice to improve your financial situation.

technicalPrinciples.title: Technical Principles
technicalPrinciples.intro: Goalvest's asset allocation recommendations are based on the following core investment theories:
technicalPrinciples.mptDesc: Reduce risk through diversification and pursue maximum returns at a given risk level.
technicalPrinciples.lifecycleDesc: Adjust the proportion of risky assets based on age - take more risk when young and become more conservative as you age.
technicalPrinciples.goalDesc: Start from goals and work backwards to determine required savings and investment strategies.
technicalPrinciples.noteDesc: The above theories are for reference only. Actual investment decisions should consider individual circumstances and market conditions.

privacy.title: Privacy Protection
privacy.intro: We deeply understand the sensitivity of financial data, so we have adopted the strictest privacy protection measures:
privacy.item1: All data is stored only in your local browser
privacy.item2: No user data is collected, uploaded, or stored on servers
privacy.item3: No account registration required, no personal information needed
privacy.item4: You can clear browser data at any time to delete all information

team.title: Our Team
team.intro: Goalvest was created by a group of independent developers passionate about fintech. Our team members come from finance, technology, and product design fields, dedicated to bringing professional financial planning tools to everyone.
team.visionDesc: Enable everyone to easily conduct financial planning and achieve their financial goals. We believe that good tools should be simple to use, protect privacy, and be freely available to all.

service.title: Service Description
service.intro: Goalvest is a goal-oriented asset planning tool designed to help users with personal financial planning and asset allocation analysis. The features provided by this application include but are not limited to:
service.freeTool: This service is a free tool, and we reserve the right to modify or terminate the service at any time without notice.

disclaimer.title: Important Disclaimer
disclaimer.notInvestmentAdvice: This application does not provide investment advice.
disclaimer.notInvestmentAdviceDesc: All information, analysis results, and asset allocation recommendations provided by Goalvest are for reference and educational purposes only and do not constitute any form of investment advice, financial advice, or professional financial consulting.
disclaimer.investmentRisk: Investment involves risk, and past performance does not guarantee future returns. Before making any investment decisions, you should:

conservative.description: Focus on capital preservation with stable returns, suitable for those near retirement or with low risk tolerance

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.subtitle: For most investors
balanced.description: Balanced equity and debt, balancing returns and risk, suitable for middle-aged people with stable income

growth.name: Growth
growth.subtitle: For young investors
growth.description: Pursuit of long-term growth with higher volatility, suitable for young people or those with long investment horizons

custom.name: Custom

distribution.amount: Amount = Existing Asset Allocation + Annual Surplus Allocation

validation.cashTooLow: Cash assets should be at least 10% to maintain liquidity

suggestions.title: Allocation Suggestions
suggestions.cashLiquidity: Cash assets should be kept at 10%-20% to ensure liquidity needs
suggestions.ageRule: Adjust risk asset ratio based on age: 100 - age = maximum equity assets
suggestions.rebalance: Regular rebalancing: Check allocation ratios quarterly, adjust when deviation exceeds 5%
suggestions.longTerm: Long-term holding: Avoid frequent trading and enjoy compound growth

cash.name: Cash/Money Market Funds
cash.description: Available anytime, highest liquidity, lower returns

fixed_income.name: Fixed Income
fixed_income.description: Bonds, bank wealth management, etc., stable returns, lower risk

index_fund.name: Index Funds
index_fund.description: Track market indices, substantial long-term returns, with volatility

stock_fund.name: Active Stock Funds
stock_fund.description: Fund managers select stocks, pursuing excess returns, higher volatility

gold.name: Gold
gold.description: Safe-haven asset, hedge against inflation, low correlation with stock market

insurance.name: Insurance/Annuity
insurance.description: Protection + savings, locking in long-term returns, poor liquidity

projection.subtitle: Predict future asset growth based on current allocation plan

settings.title: Projection Settings
settings.compoundDesc: Compound: Returns are added to principal, earning interest on interest
settings.simpleDesc: Simple: Returns are not added to principal

advice.title: Investment Advice
advice.fixedStability: Fixed income portion grows steadily, suitable as the "ballast" of the asset portfolio
advice.equityLongTerm: Equity investments have higher long-term returns but require bearing short-term volatility, recommended to hold for 5+ years
advice.ageAdjustment: As you age, gradually reduce equity ratio and increase fixed income ratio
advice.annualReview: Review allocation annually and adjust based on market conditions and personal goals
